title: Internship in the Wholesale Banking Network Sector Coverage team (NFR focus)
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
ING is a global bank with a strong European base. Our 57,000 employees serve around38.9 million customers, corporateclientsand financial institutions in over 40 countries. Our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and in business.
ING’s Wholesale Bank (WB) helps companies,institutionsand governmentsto gainaccess to capital in support of their success and further growth. WeprovideM&A advice, capital structuring advice, help companies hedge their FX, interest and commodity risk, support daily paymentrequirementsand finance a variety of assets throughout the different sectors.
The Network Sector Coverage (NSC) team is part of ING Wholesale Banking. The team is based in Amsterdam andoperatesas the first point of contact for Dutch companies when there is also a global relationship with corporate headquarters. The NSC bankersare responsible fordeveloping strategic relationships with these subsidiaries. They position ING well for future opportunities and proactively support new strategic NSC business origination, all within the parameters of the WB segmentation strategy. The team also coordinates between various products, so that the clients’ needs are met.Customer experience is what differentiates us, and ING is continuously innovating to improve it.
As an Intern of the NSCteamyou will work in a challenging and dynamic environment. You will be part of a professional,experiencedand enthusiastic team with an open atmosphere. Working in the team will give you an excellent opportunity to become acquainted with many aspects ofbankingbusiness.
The companies we cover are related to various sectors ranging from retail to industrial companies. As aNonFinancialRiskinternyou will be a member ofNFRsupport team of the sector, supporting daily operations on KYC. You will be helping the bank to remain compliant andassistingcorporate clients to offboard their products. You workmost closelytogether with members of different teams in Amsterdam as well as with ING colleagues all over the world. However, as we have offices in Frankfurt, London,Singaporeand Brussels you will come across a variety of colleagues.
Roles and responsibilities
As an Intern your job will be diverse, but your main tasks consist of:
Support front office / client outreach team to manage day to day KYC activities
Maintaining data reporting on offboarding and taking necessary action where needed
Maintaining contact with various internal and external stakeholders
Be willing toparticipatein cross-sector projects supporting KYC pillars
We aim to give you an experience that comes close to what you will be doing if you decide to start a banking career.
Well-organized /accurate
Energetic with a proactive attitude
Enrolled in a (HBO or University)Bachelor‘s degree
A reliable team player who is highly motivated and eager to learn
Able tooperatein a fast-paced work environment while stillmaintainingstructure
A proactive approach, especially in a (part) working from home environment
During the duration of your internship at ING, it is mandatory to be enrolled at a Dutch university (or EU-university for EU passport holders).
You’llalsobenefitfrom:
• Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on36 hourswork week
• Your own work laptop
• Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
• Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
• An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
We are looking forward to receiving your CV and motivation letter. Don’t hesitate to be original and show who you really are. For any further questions please contact Luba de Haas-Nakropina at +31 62 537 17 92
About our internships
Every year, more than 350 students join our internship program. While there are no guarantees about your future, many of our former interns move into a permanent role or onto our International TalentProgramme(traineeship).
Whatever happens, an internship at ING is the ideal opportunity to meet a wide variety of people, to build up your own network, and to learn about manydifferent aspectsof banking – put simply,it’sa great start to your career.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
